projects.name: AI Career Coach (sensai)
projects.description: A full-stack AI-powered career guidance platform built with Next.js and Node.js that gives users personalised career advice, resume suggestions, interview prep and role-specific insights.
highlights: Authentication with Clerk and database operations through Prisma ORM
Google Gemini API integration for AI-driven career advice
Background workflows handled with Inngest

projects.name: E-Commerce Store
projects.description: A full-stack MERN e-commerce platform with product and category management, a shopping cart, coupon codes, Stripe checkout and an admin dashboard with sales analytics.
highlights: REST APIs on Node.js/Express and MongoDB, secured with JWT access and refresh tokens
Performance optimised with Redis caching; media managed with Cloudinary
Payments integrated via Stripe; state managed with Zustand

projects.name: contextforge
projects.description: A self-hostable docs answer bot that answers only from your own docs, cites its sources and abstains when retrieval confidence is too low, logging the question to an admin queue.
highlights: Hallucination guard abstains when an answer cites a chunk that was never retrieved
Offline eval harness with a 30-case golden dataset for accuracy and hallucination rate
Embeddable one-script widget plus streaming chat API

projects.name: pulseboard-ops
projects.description: A lightweight, self-hosted incident radar that ingests Stripe, GitHub and custom events, evaluates them against rules and pushes alerts to a live dashboard, Slack and email.
highlights: Three signature-verified ingestion paths plus a custom event SDK
Rule engine with pattern, threshold and spike conditions and cooldowns
Redis-backed per-key rate limiting and role-based multi-tenant auth

projects.name: Enterprise Employee Portal
projects.description: An HR self-service portal for leave, timesheets, documents and the org chart, with two-stage leave approval enforced in the API and a CI/CD pipeline gated on API contract tests.
highlights: JWT sessions with 15-minute access tokens and rotating 7-day refresh tokens
Four roles with route-level and row-level permission checks
MySQL schema of 15 tables; org chart resolved by a recursive CTE

projects.name: traceboard
projects.description: A requirements traceability tool that links requirements, tests, code and defects, and flags stale coverage where a test still passes against a requirement that has since changed.
highlights: Four coverage states: covered, stale-covered, failing and uncovered
Demo exposes the gap between 57% reported and 29% true coverage
Immutable requirement versions and Markdown audit packs

projects.name: resumable
projects.description: Server-sent events with a real Last-Event-ID contract over a bounded replay buffer and an explicit gap signal, so reconnecting clients never silently skip events.
highlights: Delivered all 24,540 events with 0 lost across 1,000 simulated reconnects
Explicit GAP outcome reports missed events and a snapshot to rebase on
Suite of 20 tests covering ordering, duplicates and off-by-one edges

projects.name: tokenforge
projects.description: One design-token JSON source forged into a Tailwind theme, CSS variables for light, dark and high-contrast modes, and a typed TypeScript module, with a WCAG contrast gate for CI.
highlights: Contrast check exits non-zero when a declared pair misses its WCAG level
Drift detector reports added, removed and changed token values
Covered by a Vitest suite of 104 tests
